feature_schema.source_edge_metadata: retained verbatim in authenticated graph JSON
feature_schema.input_allowlist: compiler categories, operation text, numeric compiler facts; no target/candidate/QoR/budget fields

units.area: arithmetic mean of resource utilization percentages
units.adp: ms * area; equivalent within clock pools to cycles * area ordering/regret
units.resources: physical BRAM18K,DSP,FF,LUT from measured percentages and authenticated device capacities

measurement_policy: successfully preprocessed complete HLS designs; failures/unknown excluded, never labelled infeasible
